skill.displayName: AI Bikini Photo Editor-AI Editor for Swimwear & Bikini Photos – API-powered
skill.summary: AI bikini photo editor — edit a person photo into a bikini scene with a required prompt

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-bikini-photo-editor-openapi-skill.
- Allows editing a person photo into a bikini scene using an AI-powered OpenAPI.
- Supports image upload and custom description for bikini scene.
- Requires a WeShop API key for authentication.
- Provides endpoints for starting runs, polling status, and uploading images.
- Includes clear instructions for secure API key usage.
